mapper.select: SELECT A.REVIEW_ID, A.PRODUCT_ID, A.ORDER_ID, A.USER_NO, A.RATING, A.CONTENTS, A.ATCH_DOC_ID, A.DISPLAY_YN, A.REGIST_DT, U.USER_NM FROM tb_product_reviews A INNER JOIN op_user U ON A.USER_NO = U.USER_NO WHERE A.REVIEW_ID = #{reviewId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_product_reviews ( PRODUCT_ID, ORDER_ID, USER_NO, RATING, CONTENTS, ATCH_DOC_ID, DISPLAY_YN, REGISTER_NO, REGIST_DT ) VALUES ( #{productId}, IFNULL(#{orderId}, 0), #{ss_user_no}, #{rating}, #{contents}, #{atchDocId}, 'Y', #{ss_user_no}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_product_reviews SET DISPLAY_YN = 'Y', UPDUSR_NO = #{ss_user_no}, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE REVIEW_ID = #{reviewId}
